title: Callvale after: findings in one place
claim: Detection services run in every account, and their findings flow into AWS Security Hub in the security account.
alt: The same seven accounts. Amazon GuardDuty, Amazon Inspector, Amazon Macie and AWS Config run in each account. The security account is the delegated administrator and holds AWS Security Hub and Amazon Detective. Findings flow from every account into Security Hub. AWS Artifact supplies the AWS audit reports for the bank.
